# Quantum Performance Inc.

> > Mental performance coaching and training for athletes to build focus, confidence, and peak performance under pressure.

Quantum Performance Inc., led by mental performance coach Kate Allgood, provides 1-on-1 coaching, team training, digital apps, and assessments for athletes worldwide. The company specializes in sport psychology, mindset training, and performance psychology through personalized coaching, The Athlete Within App, TAIS assessments, and educational resources.

## Key Topics

- Mental Performance Coaching

## Core Coaching Services

- [Mental Performance Coach for Athletes | Quantum Performance Inc.](https://www.qpathlete.com/mindset-coaching): 1:1 mental performance coaching with Kate Allgood for focus and confidence.
- [Virtual Mental Performance Coaching | Quantum Performance Inc](https://www.qpathlete.com/virtual-mental-performance-training): Virtual 1-on-1 mental performance coaching available worldwide.
- [Mental Skills Training for Teams | Quantum Performance Inc.](https://www.qpathlete.com/mental-skills-training-teams): Team mental skills training for focus, communication, and performance.
- [San Diego Mental Performance Coach | Quantum Performance Inc.](https://www.qpathlete.com/san-diego-mental-performance-coach): San Diego-based mental performance coaching for local athletes.
- [Mental Performance Coaching for Los Angeles Athletes | Quantum Performance](https://www.qpathlete.com/mental-performance-coaching-los-angeles): Remote mental performance coaching for Los Angeles athletes.

## Assessment & Digital Tools

- [TAIS Assessment for Athletes, Coaches & Teams | Quantum Performance](https://www.qpathlete.com/assessment): TAIS assessment revealing attention and decision-making patterns for athletes.
- [The Athlete Within App | Mental Training for Athletes](https://www.qpathlete.com/the-athlete-within-app): The Athlete Within App with guided mental training and game day tools.
